tagline: Hairpins up onto the mesa, then out to the edge.
intro: SR-313 leaves US-191 about nine miles north of Moab and climbs Sevenmile Canyon through a series of hairpin curves onto the plateau, where the road mellows out. Out on the Big Flat it divides. One fork runs out along the ridges to Dead Horse Point. The other goes into Canyonlands on the Island in the Sky road and ends at Grand View Point.

The Island in the Sky is a broad, level mesa between the Colorado and the Green. Its viewpoints look 1,200 feet down to the White Rim, a sandstone bench, and the rivers lie another 1,000 feet below that.

moments.title: Monitor and Merrimac
moments.text: From the view areas in Sevenmile Canyon two rock formations come into sight, named after the Civil War warships Monitor and Merrimac.

moments.title: Dead Horse Point
moments.text: The road ends at an overlook 2,000 feet above the Colorado, on a point that legend says cowboys used as a natural corral, where horses often died of exposure.

moments.title: Aztec Butte
moments.text: Off the Upheaval Dome road, a half-mile walk and a short scramble reach stone granaries that Ancestral Puebloans built near the top between about 1200 and 1300.
